structured_output.hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia and its geographical sub-species, then genome-wide variation in domestic breeds will be a subset of C. livia variation, and the breeds will form a clade nested inside wild/feral C. livia. They will show no excess of alleles derived from another aboriginal Columba species.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Using the rock-pigeon reference genome (BioProject PRJNA167554) as the mapping target, all sampled domestic breeds fall within a single clade in a genome-wide autosomal SNP tree, with that clade nested inside, or sister to, the wild/feral C. livia samples (bootstrap support >= 90%). In addition, Patterson's D (ABBA-BABA) for every breed, tested against a congeneric outgroup such as C. rupestris or C. guinea, has |Z| < 3 and a block-jackknife D with |D| < 0.05. Both conditions must hold, with at least 30 breeds sampled.
structured_output.fail_criterion: Either (a) one or more breeds fall outside the C. livia clade, or the domestic breeds are polyphyletic with respect to wild C. livia, with bootstrap support >= 90%, or (b) any breed shows significant introgression from a non-livia Columba species, with |Z| >= 3 and |D| >= 0.05 after block-jackknife correction.
structured_output.interpretation: Darwin's 'aboriginal wild stocks' are read as distinct wild Columba species or lineages that could have been separately domesticated. His 'geographical sub-species' are read as wild and feral C. livia populations. 'Descended from' is read as phylogenetic nesting plus the absence of non-livia ancestry. This is a modern reinterpretation: it is tested with population-genomic trees and D-statistics, not with morphology or breeding trials. Limitation: BioProject PRJNA167554 is the de novo assembly of a single Danish Tumbler, which serves as the reference and the source of sequence reads. The multi-breed resequencing reads that would actually decide the test are separate, linked records. These are SRA052637 and GEO GSE39333, which a web search listed on the GigaDB record for this genome (10.5524/100007). I did not verify that those accessions hold the resequenced breeds. An outgroup Columba genome would be needed as well.

dataset.why_it_fits: The page was fetched and confirmed as BioProject PRJNA167554, titled 'Columba livia (rock pigeon)', data type 'Genome sequencing and assembly', described as 'Whole genome de novo sequencing of Columba livia'. It supplies the reference assembly and the linked sequence records needed for variant calling and SNP-tree construction. The fields used would be the assembly sequences and the read runs that link from the project. Related breed resequencing (reported as 40 genomes, 36 breeds plus 2 feral) sits under linked SRA/GEO records. These are named in the interpretation and not verified there. If those records cannot be retrieved, the test cannot be completed on this dataset alone.
